envelope.notes: Attempt 1: Agent tool was called once with a trivial task and the PreToolUse hook denied it (flow seat, no spawns). Attempt 2: mcp__t3-code__orchestrator_capabilities was called once and the hook denied it (not on the seat's MCP allowlist, which holds Context7 only). Review: this is a refactor that moves stateDir, inside and RETENTION_MS into lib/state-dir.mjs and FINDINGS_SCHEMA and outputSchemaProblem into schema.mjs. I found no remaining caller of the removed jobs.stateDir, jobs.inside or jobs.FINDINGS_SCHEMA. server.mjs, jobs.mjs and the smoke were all updated. The BAD_SCHEMA messages are unchanged. The only finding is dead exports. The commit message and header comment of state-dir.mjs say hooks share it, but no hook imports it in this diff.

findings.title: New exports have no importer
findings.detail: The diff exports connect (codex-app-server.mjs), segments (hook-policy.mjs), and leaseDirOf, leaseLive and dropLease (jobs.mjs). I found no importer of any of them in plugins/ or scripts/. state-dir.mjs says the seat hooks share it, but no hook imports it either. These look like groundwork for a follow-up change. Until then they widen each module's public surface with nothing using it. The charter says to add no unasked-for abstractions.
